text:
Lord, You watered the fields with flowers

that fill the air with aroma and freshness,

you covered the heavens with immense splendors

and gave the seas their eternal murmur.


Everywhere your matchless love shines;

the earth proclaims your glory everywhere;

and amid those hymns that spring from the world,

I want to raise to you my voice of pleasure.

translation.title: Offering
translation.editorial_note: The translation keeps the hymn of fields, heavens, seas, and grateful voice.
